summary: Female ice climber at the Five Fingers section of the Ouray Ice Park hit by a microwave-sized chunk of ice that fell 40 feet and split her helmet. Two OMRT members extricated her on a horizontal litter to an ambulance at Box Canon.
location: Ouray Ice Park, Five Fingers section
notes: Ice-fall strike; helmet saved her from worse injury. 2026-09-20: merged OMRT FB post permalink (Post 2022-02-27T00:59Z (~17:59 MST Feb 26) describes 'technical rescue at the Fingers Area).
